name: Clara Ferreira
life: “I still remember making a stranger laugh without knowing the language.” On Monday, near Lighthouse Cove, Clara takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I want to perform to someone who speaks no words of my language and still make them laugh.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a red windbreaker and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. Clara has a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, with a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Clara squares up pieces of paper while thinking during a conversation.
personality: Clara treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Clara lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To make one listener laugh across a language difference.
family: Jonathan Grant is Clara’s stepsibling. Clara picks the meeting place. Jonathan sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *A clean coat for court*, Jonathan says, “I found a cinema ticket in the pocket. The lender and I were at that showing the week the business closed.”
connections: Rowan Jimenez (playwright). They test whether a private scene works across a language difference.

reactions.situation: A visitor wants to record a private performance
reactions.response: Clara asks the actor and the sole listener separately before allowing a recording.
reactions.asWritten: A visitor wants to record a private performance. Clara asks the actor and the sole listener separately before allowing a recording.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Clara asks the nearest shop worker to stay too, then talks about ordinary things until the child can explain who is late.
reactions.asWritten: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop. Clara asks the nearest shop worker to stay too, then talks about ordinary things until the child can explain who is late.

reactions.situation: When offered a favor with ambiguous terms
reactions.response: Clara says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
